environment.description: Same provider binary deployed on RHEL 9 with a custom SELinux type enforcement module (terraform_provider_t). The TE module confines the provider process to type terraform_provider_t which has file transition rules limited to terraform_workspace_t labeled paths. The policy uses a narrow type_transition rule: only files under paths labeled terraform_workspace_t (applied via semanage fcontext to /opt/terraform/workspaces(/.*)?) can be created or written. The module also includes a dontaudit rule for file { write create } on all other types, meaning denials are suppressed from audit log but still enforced. Additionally, the boolean terraform_provider_can_network is set to off, preventing any network exfiltration of data. The provider binary itself is labeled terraform_provider_exec_t with automatic domain transition on exec.

config.selinux_policy: targeted with custom terraform_provider_t module v2.1
config.type_enforcement_rules: allow terraform_provider_t terraform_workspace_t:file { read write create unlink getattr open }; allow terraform_provider_t terraform_provider_exec_t:file { execute read getattr }; dontaudit terraform_provider_t ~terraform_workspace_t:file { write create append };
config.note: dontaudit suppresses AVC denial messages but enforcement remains active
